title: Spring Vegetable Stir Fry
description: A light and refreshing Thai-inspired stir fry made with spring vegetables and zesty flavors.

ingredients.name: Pasta (rice noodles or egg noodles)
ingredients.notes: preferably fresh or stored in a dry place

instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic, ginger, and chili and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the bell pepper and onion and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
Add the noodles and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add the soy sauce and honey (if using) and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer to a serving platter and garnish with chopped fresh herbs (if desired).
